short_scenes.caption: "STOP!"
short_scenes.narration: Stop! Mia stepped between them, torch blazing. Zor hesitated. He had loved her, once.

short_scenes.caption: John had the spear at his throat.
short_scenes.narration: In that moment, John rose and knocked him down. The spear point rested at Zor's throat.

short_scenes.caption: He lowered the spear.
short_scenes.narration: Kill him, the forest seemed to whisper. But John looked at Leo. And lowered the spear.

short_scenes.caption: "Why?"
short_scenes.narration: Why? Zor asked. Because my son is watching, John said.
